I've attached our vendor intake questionnaire (we use this to capture vendor controls and timelines). A few quick notes up front so your team can prepare: 
- We require a copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary if the full report is restricted.
- For regulated workloads we need confirmation on data residency and an initial GDPR/HIPAA mapping.
- Important: our legal team needs explicit breach notification windows in the vendor agreement. Typical asks are an initial notification within 24 hours of detection and a fuller remediation timeline (we can discuss exact SLA in a call).
- For BCP/DR evidence we accept runbook excerpts, a tabletop/test summary from the last 12 months, and contact points for DR activation.

Hi Aline — Neha here (Head of Security Operations at Redwood). Jonas looped me in. Thanks for the clear asks — we can provide everything you listed. Short answers and attachments below; see full notes inline in the questionnaire after we return it.

SOC 2:
- Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering infrastructure, change management, access controls and incident response. The full report is restricted; we are including a SOC2-typeII-summary.pdf that lists in-scope systems and date range. If you need a full report we can provide it under NDA / controlled access.

GDPR / HIPAA:
- We support GDPR controls and have a documented data processing addendum (DPA) for customers. For HIPAA we have controls and BAAs for customers handling PHI; we will map the specific data flows once you confirm sample data types.

Incident response & breach notification (high-level):
- Detection & Triage: our SOC/monitoring team triggers IR within the first hour when a qualified detection occurs.
- Initial Notification: Redwood aims to provide an initial notification to impacted customers within 24 hours of confirming a security incident affecting their data.
- Root-cause / Remediation Update: we provide substantive updates within 72 hours and a final remediation report within a reasonable timeframe depending on complexity (typically 1-3 weeks).
- We can include contract language to align on these windows if needed. See attached IR-notification-flow.pdf for the standard escalation ladder and contacts.

BCP/DR evidence: attached is a redacted dr-runbook-excerpt.pdf and a short note on our most recent tabletop exercise (April 2025). We also include a short summary of our recovery RTO/RPO targets in the SOC2 summary.

I've completed the top-level sections of the attached questionnaire; please see comments. If helpful, Marissa (Customer Success) can run a short joint call to align on timelines and legal asks.

Attachments included: SOC2-typeII-summary.pdf; IR-notification-flow.pdf; dr-runbook-excerpt.pdf

Next steps (proposal):
- I will upload the completed questionnaire (annotated) back to you by EOD Monday, 21 July.
- Suggest a 30-minute call week of July 21 — Neha + Jonas + Marissa vs your security/legal lead to confirm notification contract language and any residency requirements.

Regards,
